# Exam Management

This module is part of the testing framework, specifically related to Babel's handling of polyfills for core-js proposals. It serves as a transitional file until Babel 8, when it will be removed.

## Module: corejs3-shipped-proposals
**Purpose** — This module is intended to facilitate the inclusion of core-js proposals in Babel's polyfill mechanism. It will be removed in Babel 8 as it is now included in `babel-plugin-polyfill-corejs3`.

**Behavior & side effects** — The module exports the contents of `corejs3-shipped-proposals.json`, which contains data related to the proposals that have been shipped in core-js. The comment indicates that this file is temporary and will be removed in a future version of Babel.

**Renders / Returns** — This module does not render any JSX elements or return a value in the traditional sense; it simply exports a JSON object.

**Usage example** — 
```javascript
const corejs3Proposals = require("path/to/corejs3-shipped-proposals");
```

**Dependencies** — 
- None
